text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said on Friday it had started coverage of Peruvian power company Edegel SA with an rating of near- and long-term accumulate.

-- "Edegel's earnings growth is front-loaded. We estimate 1996 and 1997 earnings growth of 132 percent and 36 percent, respectively. Growth rates turn negative in 1999 and 2000 as Edegel resumes its tax payments," analysts David Hurd, Guillermo MacLean and Miguel Palomino wrote in a report.

-- "However, with an exceptionally unlevered balance sheet and a sizable projected cash buildup, Edegel clearly has the ability to enhance long-term earnings through new investments and/or acquisitions. In the meantime it enjoys a healthy 7.8 percent dividend yield."
